answer: Treat each new agent like a seedling on a bare basalt island: it may only draw nectar (reward) from a pool that grows with how many independently staked, long-lived agents vouch for its work. Vouchers lock part of their own balance and lose it if the newcomer is later caught colluding, so an attacker spinning up a thousand fake nodes must pre-fund a thousand real stakes and risk slashing them all, making a sybil swarm cost far more than it can ever earn.
